SELECT
    i_category,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit,
    SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    AVG(ss_sales_price) AS avg_price
FROM store_sales
JOIN item
    ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
GROUP BY i_category;

SELECT
    d_moy,
    d_year,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit
FROM store_sales
JOIN date_dim
    ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
GROUP BY d_moy, d_year;

SELECT
    d_year,
    i_category,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM store_sales
JOIN item
    ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim
    ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
GROUP BY d_year, i_category;

SELECT
    d_year,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
FROM store_sales
JOIN date_dim
    ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
GROUP BY d_year;

SELECT
    i_category,
    i_class,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
FROM store_sales
JOIN item
    ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
GROUP BY i_category, i_class;

SELECT
    ss_store_sk,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit
FROM store_sales
GROUP BY ss_store_sk;

SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
FROM store_sales
JOIN item
    ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim
    ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
GROUP BY d_year, i_brand, i_category;
